contract.difficulty_selection: Level_LoadFromSceneState selects 006/008/010 for mode 1B and 003/006/009 for mode 1C as GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE rises from 0 to 2+.
contract.mode_1b: Interaction_UpdateResourceState enters scene-resource mode 0x1B when progress equals FF7E12.
contract.mode_1c: Interaction_UpdateResourceState enters scene-resource mode 0x1C when progress equals FF7E16.

conclusion: The two four-byte words are explicit difficulty-selected ASCII milestones, not general interaction counters.
